script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Drama
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. NEW YORK CITY - DAY

A bustling metropolis, sun-kissed buildings casting long shadows. A taxi cruises down 5th Avenue, its horn blaring impatiently.

INT. TAXI - DAY

JAMES (40s, ambitious, well-dressed) turns to the driver, eyes determined.

JAMES
I want to be someone, to make a difference.

DRIVER (50s, wise, weary) nods sympathetically.

DRIVER
You have the ambition. The rest is up to you.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits at his small kitchen table, poring over a map of the city. He highlights districts with a red pen.

JAMES (to himself)
I'll start here...

EXT. LOW-INCOME NEIGHBORHOOD - DAY

James, carrying a backpack filled with supplies, approaches a community center.

INT. COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

James meets with MR. RODRIGUEZ (60s, experienced, kind-hearted), the center's director.

MR. RODRIGUEZ
Welcome, James. What can I help you with?

JAMES
I want to start a program for the kids here. Something productive, to give them a sense of purpose.

MR. RODRIGUEZ (smiling)
You're a good man, James. I'll do what I can to help you.

INT. CLASSROOM - DAY

James stands before a group of eager, curious children. He begins to teach them the basics of coding.

JAMES
Alright, kids, today we're going to learn how to make a simple computer game.

A montage of the children working diligently, James guiding them, and their faces beaming with pride as their game comes to life on the screen.

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - NIGHT

James sits at the kitchen table, exhausted yet fulfilled. He stares at a map of the city, the red highlights now replaced with small green dots representing the community centers where he's implemented his program.

INT. LUXURY APARTMENT - NIGHT

Elizabeth (30s, successful, cold) sits in her high-rise apartment, watching the news coverage of James' program on her flat-screen TV.

ELIZABETH
(to herself)
Another do-gooder. I could do that, but why bother?

INT. JAMES' APARTMENT - DAY

James sits at the kitchen table, exhausted but optimistic. The phone rings. It's Elizabeth, offering him a job at her corporation.

JAMES
(determined)
No, thank you. I don't need your money or your company. I have something more valuable now.

INT. COMMUNITY CENTER - DAY

James stands in the center of a bustling room filled with children coding, laughing, and learning.

MR. RODRIGUEZ
(proudly)
You've made quite an impact, James.

JAMES (smiling)
It's just the beginning.

FADE OUT.

The end.
